transit_lane_the_archetype.archetype: the MATA transit lane = THE efficiency archetype: Memphis runs transit at roughly one-fifth to one-half the per-resident dollars of every banked functioning peer (banked mata_diagnosis_v1)
transit_lane_the_archetype.service_cut_arc_banked: fixed-route service hours 320,000/yr (2017) -> 215,000/yr (2026); VRH bus 261k (2022) -> 216k (2025); OTP ~60% through 2026; missed trips 26-30% of scheduled late-2025 -> 7% by Oct-2026 (trustee-reported)
transit_lane_the_archetype.governance_lane_banked: unrestricted net deficit -$90M (2014) / -$91M (2019) disclosed only 2024-09-10; full board replaced Oct 2024 (Young); 5 resignations Sept 2025; city trust + trustee at $75,000/month from Sept 2025; 4 CEOs/interims in 30 months

lane_leak_reads_banked: TRANSIT: $82/city-res ops (NTD 2024) vs Cincy $514 / STL $1,041 / Detroit $264 — 5.7x-12.7x below the functioning peers; the ranked-cause-1 funding-starved lane (mata_diagnosis_v1 diagnosis.ranked_causes[0])
GOVERNANCE-OVERHEAD LEAK: trustee cost $75,000/month + $1.3M TransPro crisis contract + $336K diagnostic — dollars spent on failure-of-institutions, not service
SERVICE-DELIVERY LEAK: 23->18 routes Nov-2024, 60-min headways everywhere, trolley suspended since 2024-08; a case-study rider took 6 hrs for a 3-mile grocery trip (WREG, banked)

FEDERAL/STATE REPLACEMENT FLAG: the crime-delta since Sept-2025 is carried by the MSTF external op (13,020 arrests by Sept-2026) + TN $100M Downtown Public Safety Grant — OUTSIDE the city ledger; the city-budget efficiency instrument does NOT score it (memphis_care_cage_series_v1 task_force_attribution)
memphis_deep_dive.care_cage_ratio_band_banked: NO INVERSE FINGERPRINT IN THE CITY BOOKS — the founder's pre-registered lens is CONFIRMED STRUCTURALLY
memphis_deep_dive.the_2024_care_jump_banked: FY2024 care jumps +31% (Grants & Subsidies 48.3M->82.9M actual; Parks 40.9M->49.9M). This is the mayorial-transition year (Paul Young took office Jan 2024). Cage rose only +7%. The city-side response to the crime-emergency era was a CARE-lead, not a DETERRENCE-lead.

elasticities_cross_check_banked.note: the delta lane's per-city rho cells (Mem -0.30, CIN -0.72, STL +0.543) are the direction cross-check on the residual arcs — a city whose dln-care reads murder-down is consistent with a negative efficiency trend when care rose

guards.measurement_order_law: efficiency is measured AFTER the fitted equation accounts for inputs/need/structure: the residual is what the within-city FE frame does NOT explain from the banked care/cage/bookings/need/structure lanes at that city-year's input levels
guards.composition_guard: every panel row carries need_structure_context (care_per_100k, cage_per_100k, cost_burden 30%+ share, median home value, SNAP share, bachelors share, unemployment) so the rank can be checked against the context columns: e.g. St. Louis ranks worst on raw murder level but its FE-3 residual mean is a different read; the rank is NOT a poverty-rank re-derivation because the poverty/need columns entered the prediction

honest_nulls.PIT_homelessness_2013_and_2016: HUD published nothing at the per-CoC report route for ANY CoC in 2013 + 2016 (verified 8/8 = 404) — banked null in pit_homelessness_lane_v1, never backfilled
honest_nulls.PIT_grain: CoC (count-of-care) grain; not blended into the city-year panel (grain-law)
honest_nulls.eviction_lane_2020_21: court closures/CTR pause: Eviction Lab published no 2019-2020 standardized judgment rates; 2020-21 rows carry covid_freeze_flag=1 (banked)
honest_nulls.health_lane_grain: life-expectancy + drug-poisoning = COUNTY grain only; shipped as companion, never blended into the city-year panel (banked grain-law)
honest_nulls.Denver: no murder-rate denominator rows banked in the panel window; zero efficiency rows
honest_nulls.NYC: single complete predicted city-year (2001); no city rank computed
honest_nulls.bookings_facility_non_NYC: facility-grain bookings honest-null for Detroit/St. Louis Metro/Shelby(Memphis)/Harris/Orleans routes-tried-no-capture; the bookings column rides the UCR-arrest intake proxy (care_bookings_ordering_v1), labeled as proxy
honest_nulls.grad: grad lane carries 4 banked city-year cells only (CIN/STL/MEM 2023, NYC 2001) — secondary column, not an efficiency outcome

guards.no_causal_claims: this instrument is descriptive + direction-class ONLY; n=4-5 city-years per city on the anchor frame; every rank cell carries its n; no administration is CAUSALLY credited or charged by this read
guards.small_n_flags: every city with <8 city-years flagged in the rank table (ALL of them are — max n=5 on the anchor)
guards.multi_actor_guard_memphis: the 2025+ Memphis crime-delta coincides with the federal MSTF deployment; the Young-administration boundary read covers the residual BEFORE/at the deployment edge and cannot separate them at this n
guards.sign_convention: EFFICIENCY = ACTUAL - PREDICTED murder-rate; NEGATIVE residual = better-than-model = efficient delivery; POSITIVE = underperformer
